item.title: There's no such thing as a small software team anymore
item.description:
📝 A small team today, running 20-100 agents in parallel, might generate 500 commits/200 pushes/100 PRs. 100+ coding agents running in parallel have to work well independently. Agents are also extremely context-limited.
🔗 Read more: https://jacob.gold/posts/theres-no-such-thing-as-a-small-software-team/

item.title: Detecting scraper bots through scroll behaviour
item.description:
📝 They recorded data of different agents and humans navigating through their website. 4%, which is not that bad. Conclusion Scroll behaviour seems to be a relevant data point for distinguishing bots from humans, and Burstiness and Memory have proven to have predictive power in a controlled environment.
🔗 Read more: https://niki.cat/detecting-scraper-bots-through-scroll-behaviour
